content.introduction: The next economic release from the CME Group is scheduled for Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 07:30 AM CT. This release includes the US International Trade in Goods and Services consensus, forecasted at -$88.6B, with an expected value of -$99.0B. The previous release on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, was a speech by John Williams, moderated a discussion before the 2026 Governance & Culture Reform Conference organized by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. The next release after November 4 is on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 07:30 AM CT, featuring the EMU Market Mover Report.
